en: Sepia-toned postcard image showing a quiet rural landscape at dusk or dawn. In the middle distance stands a tall, slender church spire with Gothic features rising above trees. In the foreground is a calm body of water with reeds along the bank, reflecting parts of the scene. A crescent moon appears in the sky on the left and a flock of birds flies across the right side. The lower left corner bears the printed artist's name: 'ALLAN BARRAUD.'
